==Dialogue==
;During {{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}
:'''Jinling:''' Sob... Sob... I-I'm scared...

:'''Jinling:''' I-if the fog never goes away, does that mean I'm never gonna go home...

:'''Linfu:''' Don't worry. Those amazing Xuanfang Wardens are already on their way.

:'''Linfu:''' They'll take care of those bad Autopuppets in no time! And before we even know it, you'll be back home in Jinzhou, and I'll be heading back to Xianling Village.

:'''Linfu:''' I'll give you a Rafter Kite as a present by then, Jinling. Ugh, but it's only a copy of what they have at the Ministry of Development, so I'm not sure if it can actually fly...

:'''Jinling:''' A Rafter Kite...? Really?

:'''Linfu:''' For real. And it's the same color as the Xuanling Bird. But hey, if you want a different color, you can pick whatever you like. We're friends, you know.
----
;After
:'''Jinling:''' Thank you, Linfu. The Rafter Kite you made is adorable. I'll keep it with me at all times.

:'''Jinling:''' It's time for me to go back to Jinzhou... Here, this is for you.

:'''Jinling:''' They're called Star Flakes. A snack from Jinzhou. You can make wishes after eating them, and they might even come true!

:'''Linfu:''' Hehe... Thank you. I'll take it home and share it with my mom tonight.

:'''Linfu:''' Will you come along whenever your parents come to Xuanfang Hold for business every year, Jinling? I really want to hang out with you more.

:'''Jinling:''' I will, it's a promise. Let's meet up again next year! Next time, tell me more about that little blue bird, okay?
{{Dialogue End}}
